page.content:
Yeoman war-bow that is Robin's defining craft.

How Longbow connects

  • Artist: Robin of Sherwood — Robin is defined by mastery of the longbow.
  • Event: Archery contest — The contest is a public trial of the longbow.

What is Longbow?

The English longbow is the legend's tool and test: splitting the wand, the sheriff's contest, and the last arrow from Kirklees. It marks Robin as yeoman, not knight.

Key threads lead to Robin of Sherwood and Archery contest.
